description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic and Kitchen Finks trigger.
Resolve the Hardened Academic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.
